text:
samir patel: Hi team - first week here. Trying to demo streaming generation from my laptop. Should I be using the sandbox key or the hosted test key for local demos? Also saw a few 429s while spamming a toy prompt, any quick tips?
olivia reed: welcome! use sandbox for interactive dev demos. hosted test key is for CI/integration only. sandbox is safe but has lower quotas so you might hit 429s if you loop too fast.
jun-ho kim: +1 sandbox. also  streaming often fails behind corporate proxies because they buffer chunked responses. If you see only the first chunk then nothing, check the proxy or run the request from an unproxied network.
samir patel: how do I run unproxied? VPN blocks direct egress from my laptop. Is there an internal dev-proxy I can route through that supports streaming?
olivia reed: yes - use dev-stream-proxy (internal tools -> networking). It supports chunked responses and won't buffer. No IP whitelist needed for modern dev keys. If you need access ping infra and include last 6 of your sandbox key.
infra-bot: ACTION: sandbox-quota-request created (#SAND-789) - requesting infra review.
jun-ho kim: for the 429s: exponential backoff works best (start 500ms, double). Also check token usage per request - use shorter prompts or lower max_tokens in sandbox to stay under quota while testing.
samir patel: here's the curl I'm using:
```
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $SANDBOX_API_KEY" 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" 
  -d '{"model":"redwood-instruct-1","input":"test","stream":true}' 
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate/stream
```
It gets 1 chunk then nothing. Any immediate obvious fixes?
jun-ho kim: curl -N is good. Try adding --no-buffer too. Also test from a mobile hotspot to rule out corp proxy. If you still see stalls, post the proxy logs in the ticket.
olivia reed: CI guidance: use a hosted CI key scoped to the CI project so quotas are stable. Sandbox is ephemeral and not ideal for automated test runs.
samir patel: great, thanks. I'll attach sample request and last6 to the ticket. Appreciate the help!
